component.name: WorkFilter
component.description: Compound-pill filter row that narrows the Work / Projects / Exhibitions lists by discipline. Single-select with five options (All, Photography, Design, Video, AI). Reads each entry's data-categories attribute, hides non-matches with a 200ms fade then display:none, and hides whole sections when their list becomes empty. Selection persists to localStorage under 'work-filter'.

useCases: let visitors (especially recruiters) self-select work by discipline on the home page

commonPatterns.name: between bio and work label
commonPatterns.description: Placed once on index.astro between #about and the Work section so it can affect every list that follows.

antiPatterns.scenario: rendering more than one WorkFilter on the same page
antiPatterns.reason: Both instances would read/write the same localStorage key and fight over the global section/entry classes.
antiPatterns.alternative: Render once. If a second filter is ever needed, scope its data-categories selector and storage key.

antiPatterns.reason: The script only touches .work__entry[data-categories]; an entry without the attribute is treated as permanently visible.
antiPatterns.alternative: Every entry in work.ts must declare categories: WorkCategory[] (enforced by the interface).

antiPatterns.scenario: adding category tags to the work card UI
antiPatterns.reason: Decided against; the project description already conveys the discipline and tags would compete with it.
antiPatterns.alternative: Keep categories as invisible metadata used only by the filter.

parentConstraints: must be rendered on a page where every .work__entry has a data-categories attribute (currently only index.astro)

interactions.click: Sets the active pill, writes localStorage 'work-filter', and shows/hides matching .work__entry nodes.

responsive.mobile: Pill row becomes horizontally scrollable with hidden scrollbar; pills bleed to the page edges so they're reachable.

accessibility.keyboardSupport: native button activation (Enter / Space); tab order follows DOM
accessibility.screenReader: aria-pressed reflects the active pill; a visually-hidden aria-live region announces the new count after each change

aiHints.context: When adding a new work or project entry, declare its categories in work.ts so the filter picks it up. Categories live in the WorkCategory union ('Photography' | 'Design' | 'Video' | 'AI'); add a new value to the union AND a matching pill in WorkFilter.astro if a new discipline ships.
